name: American Goldfinch
facts: Call pattern: a long, canary-like run of twitters and warbles. Its bouncing flight call sounds like "po-ta-to-chip."
Habitat: weedy fields, roadsides and feeders. Eats almost nothing but seeds, especially thistle and sunflower.
Migration: short-distance. One of the latest nesters, waiting until midsummer when thistle seed and down are plentiful.
